name: install_fund_name
description: A-share / fund code lookup HTTP service (akshare + FastAPI)

scripts.check: sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "box-test: python3 missing, skip check"; exit 0; }; python3 -m py_compile app.py lookup.py holdings.py trade_calendar.py nav_history.py reverse.py scripts/refresh_cache.py scripts/refresh_fund_holdings.py test_holdings_live_on_miss.py test_nav_history.py test_reverse.py'
scripts.test: sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "box-test: python3 missing, skip test"; exit 0; }; PY=${VIRTUAL_ENV:+$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python}; PY=${PY:-.venv/bin/python}; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; "$PY" -m unittest test_holdings_live_on_miss.py test_nav_history.py test_reverse.py -v'
